name: Logo Ticker Mask
css: .logo-ticker-mask { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 10; pointer-events: none; mask-image: linear-gradient(270deg, transparent 0%, black 4.7%, black 95.3%, transparent 100%); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(270deg, transparent 0%, black 4.7%, black 95.3%, transparent 100%); }
